subject.title: fix(onboarding): skip setup for configured gateways and require inference first

question: Should the final landing retain the combined onboarding, profile-migration, Codex/plugin-runtime, and dependency scope, or split those owner boundaries into independently proven PRs?
rationale: The central architecture is supported, but the branch combines six compatibility-sensitive surface classes and currently has conflicts; only maintainers can decide whether the combined upgrade and ownership risk is acceptable after the concrete defect is fixed.

options.title: Repair and retain the unified branch
options.body: Fix the startup regression, resolve conflicts, and require exact-head native and upgrade proof for every retained surface.

options.title: Split sensitive owner boundaries
options.body: Land onboarding separately from profile migrations, Codex/plugin runtime identity, and dependency or packaging changes.

options.title: Pause this landing candidate
options.body: Keep the linked issues open and stop using this branch if it cannot become mergeable and independently proven.

recommendation.title: Repair and retain the unified branch
recommendation.body: Fix the startup regression, resolve conflicts, and require exact-head native and upgrade proof for every retained surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current branch, linked reports, and most of the relevant recent implementation history.
